snippet.title: Ludaro Trailer | Roguelike Ludo | EvolX Games
snippet.description:
Ludaro: Trials of the Eternal Board 🎲✨
The dice are in motion. The board is shifting. Every choice, every roll, every twist brings you closer to victory—or disaster.

Ludaro is a Roguelike Deck-building dice game with a unique twist on Ludo! Plan your moves, manipulate deterministic dice rolls, and unleash powerful Spirit Cards to beat the score. Upgrade tiles, collect quirky pets and stack wild combos as you battle in epic boss fights with game-changing modifiers.

Join Discord for exclusive rewards - https://discord.gg/Zp4R2rJq

Wishlist us on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613030/Ludaro/
